description: A student team combining software, AI, science, and health-tech to build innovative solutions for human space exploration.
summary: Aegis Health is an astronaut-focused health intelligence platform developed by Galactico Titans to monitor and manage the physical and psychological challenges of spaceflight. It enables astronauts to log daily health parameters, visualize health trends, and collaborate with medical professionals through a unified platform. Its predictive simulation engine identifies potential health risks and forecasts possible emergencies over several days, while automated alerts notify astronauts and health advisers of unusual conditions. The platform also features Bio-Twin 3D, an interactive digital representation of the human body that visualizes neurological, cardiovascular, spinal, and immune-system conditions through simplified and clinical modes. Beyond routine monitoring, its **Space Risks** module analyses the five major hazards of spaceflight: radiation, isolation, distance from Earth, altered gravity, and hostile environments, providing scenario-based simulations and recommended countermeasures. By combining health tracking, predictive analysis, expert collaboration, and interactive visualization, Aegis aims to strengthen astronaut resilience and medical self-sufficiency, enabling safer and more sustainable space station, lunar, and Martian missions.
details:
What our project does

  • Aegis helps astronauts log their health status daily and repeatedly
  • It also provides ways for astronauts to visualize their data
    • Simulation based critical scenario analysis
    • Recording parameters that were unnoticed to be a health risk
    • direct alerts from health advisors are delivered as soon as one detects something unusual
  • Moreover one of our features: commlink helps our astronauts to learn about their health status, then if they are in any serious health issue they can alert their team members and contact others. While others can also watch each other's health status to get a good grip on others health and wellbeing.
  • Even if these may seem too tedious for an astronaut, we provided an in-depth manual and guidance on the how it works tab for one to understand and utilize the program and so their won't be any misconception.

The Intended Impact:

Aegis, is a health monitoring software indeed, but it is far beyond just to show health and check-in. It is a product that is both practical on a day to day basis for an astronaut and effective when used regularly. The intended use is group based but can be used for personal purposes as well. We expect it to perform as a suitable and sustainable software in a space station and in any place. Similarly, it is expected to predict an astronaut's situation and context even when certain health parameters like cortisol levels, blood flow levels, and actual radiation dosage aren't really measurable. But even then, it can predict the situations and alert an astronaut to his unfavourable situation and successfully suggest him\her to recover from it readily. Moreover another impact of Aegis is to increase the resilience and self-sufficiency of future lunar and Mars crews as well as space station crews. As astronauts travel farther from Earth, immediate medical support becomes impossible. Aegis reduces this gap by acting as an onboard health intelligence system that continuously monitors mission health risks, predicts potential issues and recommends personalised interventions, while keeping an option for direct medical advisory from professionals. This enables a bit more of safer and more sustainable deep space exploration.

Use of Different Tools:

  • Mainly used react as programming language
  • Research and information gathering was done with ChatGPT Deep research and then validated manually
  • No idea was developed with AI
  • For coding, ai was used to make mass changes to the app when manually doing it is tedious.
  • For Development mainly Brave browser, Visual Studio Code and Codex was used
